programme.desc: Esha and Rahul fall for each other and decide to get married with the approval of their parents. However, much to her shock, he refuses her proposal when her parents come to meet him.

programme.title: Balika Badhu
programme.desc: Arduous journey of child bride Rajni who is married before she is old enough to understand what marriage is all about, against the backdrop of Indian freedom struggle.

programme.title: Veergati
programme.desc: Ajay finds it difficult to work in a corrupt society. Hence, he begins to gamble and soon finds himself helping the prostitutes who are exploited by Ekka Seth.

programme.title: Saawariya-khatu Shyam Ji Ki Amar Gatha
programme.desc: Meera, a Khatu Shyam devotee, marries Prem, a Piramal Baba devotee. Religious differences and a business rift lead to their expulsion from the house.

programme.title: Comedy Station - Bittu Bak Bak
programme.desc: Series of short, comedic vignettes where an unlucky Bhojpuri producer Champaklal and his secretary Suzie hilariously navigate chaotic, low-budget filmmaking, trying to outsmart each other.

programme.title: Comedy Station - Bittu Bak Bak
programme.desc: Series of short, comedic vignettes where an unlucky Bhojpuri producer Champaklal and his secretary Suzie hilariously navigate chaotic, low-budget filmmaking, trying to outsmart each other.

programme.title: Sangharsh
programme.desc: Reet, a police officer, learns about a religious fanatic, Pandey, who abducts children. She then joins forces with a prisoner in order to punish Pandey.

programme.title: Dahleez
programme.desc: Mrignaini and Shekhar love each other, but due to a misunderstanding, Mrignaini decides to leave him. She then marries another man. Her life comes crashing down when Shekhar reappears in her life.

programme.title: Conversation With Javed Akhtar 1
programme.desc: Lyricist, poet, screenwriter, Javed Akhtar along with film expert Nasreen Ali and Shabana Azmi, provides a fascinating and personal insight into his extraordinary life and new book Talking Life.

programme.title: Akayla
programme.desc: Inspector Vijay Verma finally manages to capture criminal mastermind Jojo. But Jojo escapes from jail and kills Vijay's friends for revenge, leaving Vijay determined to fulfil a vendetta of his own.

programme.title: Shakti
programme.desc: Ashwini, an honest policeman, refuses to trade a captured gangster for his son Vijay's release after a ruthless gangster kidnaps him. Vijay grows up resenting his father and turns to a life of crime.

programme.title: Ramji Londonwale
programme.desc: This is the story about Ramji, who is a skilled cook and flies to London to try his luck in work. It is the story about his journey and life in London.

programme.title: Disco Dancer
programme.desc: Anil's mother is falsely accused of theft and jailed. Anil swears to set this right one day. Years later, he becomes a big star and restores his mother's honour. Now his fame earns him more enemies.

programme.title: Naya Daur
programme.desc: A man brings turmoil to a peaceful village by disturbing the livelihood of the local farmers and workers. He does this by introducing new machinery in an attempt to make quicker profits.

programme.title: Dil Toh Baccha Hai Ji
programme.desc: Three roommates are in search of true love. They each find a girl with whom they fall head over heels in love with. Now they just have to get the women to reciprocate.

programme.title: Comedy Station - Bittu Bak Bak
programme.desc: Series of short, comedic vignettes where an unlucky Bhojpuri producer Champaklal and his secretary Suzie hilariously navigate chaotic, low-budget filmmaking, trying to outsmart each other.

programme.title: Shola Aur Shabnam
programme.desc: Divya loves Karan and plans to get married to him but a notorious gangster's brother, Bali, also has his eyes on her. He goes to great lengths to destroy her relationship with Karan.

programme.title: Pratigyabadh
programme.desc: Shankar grows up to become the right hand of a gangster. His goal in life is to take revenge on the moneylender who rendered his family homeless and a truck driver who molested and killed his mother.

programme.title: Bairaag
programme.desc: Manservant Bhola is secretly in love with his master's granddaughter but she is set to wed another. But the dowry-demanding groom absconds with the money and Bhola is sent to bring him back.

programme.title: Conversation With Rajkummar Rao 1
programme.desc: Rajkummar Rao, one of the most talented and versatile actors today, talks about his being an outsider to the industry, the different shades of unique characters he plays and his success.

programme.title: Rang Birangi
programme.desc: Nirmala feels the spark has gone out of her marriage with her husband, Ajay. Her brother concocts tales of an affair to help rekindle the spark in Nirmala's marriage.

programme.title: Haathkadi
programme.desc: An inspector hires four juveniles to kidnap a politician as he wants to usurp the minister's property. The juveniles have other plans for the politician, who was responsible for them going to jail.

programme.title: Tum Mere Ho
programme.desc: Snake charmer Shiva falls in love with Paro, whose father is against the relationship. But when Shiva saves Paro's life from a deadly snake, he gains her father's trust.

programme.title: Ijaazat
programme.desc: An estranged couple accidentally meet in a railway station's waiting room and revisit their past.

programme.title: Comedy Station - Dr Pran Lele
programme.desc: DR PRAN LELE, A quirky, mad-cap doctor - Dr. Pran Lele along with his crazy Nurse CPR is here to provide an abundant dose of LOLs & ROFLs as they treat their celebrity patients in their unique ways.

programme.title: Ghulam
programme.desc: Jai runs errands for Ronak Singh who is a gang lord and is involved in illegal activities. Jai's brother Siddharth decides to revolt against him and Ronak after some things goes lethally awry.

programme.title: Maidan E Jung
programme.desc: Arjun learns that his sister loves a man who is about to get married and makes efforts to unite them. But when he learns that his sister's in-laws plan to kill her, he sets out to teach them a lesson.

programme.title: Pyaar Kiya Nahin Jata

programme.title: Mohre
programme.desc: Troubled youth, lured by a newspaper ad, fall prey to escaped convicts posing as a wheelchair-bound major and his assistant. The convicts plan to harm them.

programme.title: Dooriyan
programme.desc: A married couple struggles to balance their personal and professional life which causes them to separate and it affects their child.

programme.title: Tohfa
programme.desc: Two sisters fall for the same man. One of them sacrifices her love but she is carrying a secret.

programme.title: Saajan Chale Sasural
programme.desc: A village-based singer attempts to find love and fame in the big city.

programme.title: Yaarana

programme.desc: Sister Hilda and Dr Turner support a young father with a lung condition whose wife is planning a home birth, and discover he is also coping with the repercussions of a past trauma. Cyril looks for a job that will put his qualifications to good use, a first-time mother struggles to bond with her daughter, and Fred comes up with a way to keep the wards cool during a summer heatwave.

programme.title: Catherine Cookson's The Rag Nymph
programme.desc: Feature-length period melodrama set in Victorian times, charting the relationship between feisty Newcastle rag-woman Aggie Winkowski and 10-year-old orphan Millie Forester. Determined to protect Millie from the seamy world of prostitution, Aggie resolves to take the youngster under her wing. Starring Honeysuckle Weeks, Perdita Weeks, Val McLane, Alec Newman, Crispin Bonham-Carter and Patrick Ryecart.

programme.title: Home Fires
programme.desc: The villagers prepare for harvest time, but Steph struggles to cope with the workload and faces losing the farm if she cannot meet her quota. A newcomer to the community stirs up tension between Sarah and Frances, while Joyce and the Brindsleys also receive unexpected visitors. Teresa faces a big decision, while Sarah finds herself in a dangerous situation. Alison discovers the real reason behind the parachute accidents and makes a horrifying connection to the factory. She races to warn Frances before it is too late.

programme.title: Hetty Wainthropp Investigates
programme.desc: The amateur sleuth disguises herself as a victim of domestic abuse in an attempt to find out who is threatening the future of a women's refuge. Hetty's quest to find the leak opens her eyes to the terrifying realities of spousal abuse, and results in a gripping conclusion as she leads the women in defending their sanctuary against a violent motorcycle gang.

programme.title: Sister Boniface Mysteries
programme.desc: When a local resident is found poisoned, the method resembles that of the Good Samaritan murderer several years earlier. As the culprit for that crime is known to be in a psychiatric institution, a copycat killer is suspected. Drama, starring Lorna Watson.

programme.title: Silent Witness
programme.desc: Nikki investigates a plane crash in which a former US ambassador is killed, and evidence begins to emerge that the aircraft was deliberately sabotaged.

programme.title: New Tricks
programme.desc: The squad reopens the investigation into an actress's disappearance when clips of her being assaulted in a 1990 movie are posted on the internet. Director Don Maddox features in the footage, but when questioned, he appears to have problems distinguishing fact from fiction. A potential witness is then found dead, and Brian and Jack are seconded to the unit handling the case, only to find Emily Driscoll (Dennis Waterman's daughter Hannah) is heading the operation. Imogen Stubbs and Sandra Dickinson also guest star.

programme.title: David Fuller: Monster in the Morgue
programme.desc: First of a two-part documentary about the case of David Fuller, a murderer who also sexually abused the bodies of more than 100 women and girls in a hospital mortuary.

programme.title: David Fuller: Monster in the Morgue
programme.desc: The concluding part of the documentary reveals how police made a breakthrough that led them to the man responsible for the murders of two women 33 years earlier.

programme.title: Belushi
programme.desc: The life story of comedy star John Belushi, who captured the hearts and funny-bones of audiences worldwide before his tragic and untimely death aged 33.

programme.title: Murder in Boston: Roots, Rampage and Reckoning
programme.desc: Examining the 1989 murder of Carol Stuart and the investigation that followed, which ignited racial tensions due to her husband's claims that the assailant was black.

programme.title: Murder in Boston: Roots, Rampage and Reckoning
programme.desc: After evidence against their first suspect falls apart, the Boston Police Department continues its aggressive targeting of black neighbourhoods.

programme.title: Murder in Boston: Roots, Rampage and Reckoning
programme.desc: In a shocking twist two months after the murder, Chuck Stuart commits suicide and surprising revelations emerge from his brother Matthew.

programme.title: The Directors
programme.desc: A look at the career of English director Stephen Frears, whose films include My Beautiful Laundrette, Dangerous Liaisons, The Grifters, High Fidelity, The Queen and Philomena.

programme.title: Discovering: Peter Ustinov
programme.desc: The life and career of the English actor, writer, film-maker and raconteur, who won Academy Awards for his roles in Spartacus and Topkapi.

programme.title: The 2000s
programme.sub-title: The Platinum Age of Television - Part One
programme.desc: Documentary examining the cultural and political milestones of the decade, beginning with a look at its groundbreaking TV shows, including The Sopranos and Breaking Bad.

programme.desc: A look at the life and career of the English actor, who rose to fame on the stage and became a worldwide star with his roles in the Lord of the Rings and X-Men film franchises.

programme.title: The Directors
programme.desc: A look at the life and career of John Carpenter, known for his cult classics such as Dark Star, The Thing and Halloween.

programme.title: Urban Secrets
programme.desc: Alan Cumming tours the less-celebrated sights of Brighton, beginning by visiting the Toy and Model Museum to look at its collection of model trains. He then discovers a boutique that sells a variety of unusual items, before taking a glimpse behind the scenes at the Royal Pavilion.

programme.title: Surviving Ohio State
programme.desc: Documentary exploring the scandal surrounding athletics doctor Richard Strauss, whose two-decade tenure at Ohio State University saw the sexual abuse of hundreds of students.

programme.title: On the Line: The Richard Williams Story
programme.desc: Featuring newly uncovered interviews spanning the 1980s to now, Richard Williams - the father of tennis stars Venus and Serena - retraces his family's journey from the poverty-stricken streets of Shreveport, Louisiana, to the grass courts of Wimbledon.

programme.title: My Icon: Kadeen Corbin
programme.desc: The England netball international talks about her idol.

programme.title: Bobby Robson: More Than a Manager
programme.desc: Documentary exploring the career of the much-loved former England, Barcelona and Newcastle United manager. Via the Hand of God and Paul Gascoigne's tears, to titles across Europe, Robson overcame the most extreme challenges - including fighting for his life after being diagnosed with cancer - before returning to football to manage his beloved Newcastle.

programme.desc: A look at the life and career of John Carpenter, known for his cult classics such as Dark Star, The Thing and Halloween.

programme.title: Discovering: Ian McKellen
programme.desc: A look at the life and career of the English actor, who rose to fame on the stage and became a worldwide star with his roles in the Lord of the Rings and X-Men film franchises.

programme.title: Man on Wire
programme.desc: Oscar-winning documentary about French street performer Philippe Petit. In 1974 he undertook a daring 45-minute tightrope walk and acrobatic routine on a wire stretched between the two towers of the World Trade Centre. Featuring re-creations of his earlier stunts at Paris's Notre Dame cathedral and Sydney Harbour Bridge.

programme.title: Rik Mayall: Magnificent B'stard
programme.desc: A documentary tribute to the influential and much-missed comedian, a man driven by punk spirit and an unrelenting commitment to pushing boundaries. When he died in 2014 at the age of 56, Rik left behind a body of ground-breaking work, from Rick the Poet and Kevin Turvey to The Young Ones, Bottom and The New Statesman - performances that redefined television comedy and helped ignite the alternative comedy revolution. The film explores his comedic journey, his creative partnership with Adrian Edmondson, his struggle with drink and the near-fatal quad-bike accident that left him fighting not only for his life but also his future. Contributors include Stephen Fry, Ben Elton, Greg Davies, Paul Jackson, John Lloyd, Nigel Planer and Adrian Edmondson.

programme.title: Fatboy Slim: Right Here, Right Now
programme.desc: Documentary about the Big Beach Boutique II free event held in 2002, when an estimated quarter of a million people turned up to the concert on Brighton beach.

programme.title: Val
programme.desc: Documentary focusing on the daily life of actor Val Kilmer, featuring never-before-seen footage spanning 40 years.

programme.title: Ren Faire
programme.sub-title: Daddy's Dyin', Who's Got the Will?
programme.desc: Documentary following the power struggle for control of the Texas Renaissance Festival after founder George Coulam announces his retirement. As he steps down, general manager Jeff Baldwin and kettle-corn vendor Louie Migliaccio vie for control of the festival's future.

programme.title: Ren Faire
programme.desc: George Coulam goes on an unsuccessful date, while Jeff Baldwin struggles to thwart Louie Migliaccio's bid for control of the Texas Renaissance Festival and former elephant trainer Darla Smith enters the fray with an agenda of her own.

programme.title: Ren Faire
programme.desc: Jeff Baldwin gains the upper hand over Louie Migliaccio, but Darla Smith's promotion to co-general manager leads to disastrous consequences for Jeff and herself and George Coulam finally lands on the only successor he can trust.

programme.title: Discovering: Ian McKellen
programme.desc: A look at the life and career of the English actor, who rose to fame on the stage and became a worldwide star with his roles in the Lord of the Rings and X-Men film franchises.

programme.title: Discovering: Denzel Washington
programme.desc: A look at the life and career of the American actor, who starred in Cry Freedom, Malcolm X and The Hurricane, and won Oscars for his roles in Glory and Training Day.

programme.title: Discovering: Whoopi Goldberg
programme.desc: A look into the life and career of the actress and comedian, whose breakthrough role came in The Color Purple and who won an Academy Award for Ghost.

programme.desc: A look at the life and career of Quentin Tarantino, whose films include Reservoir Dogs, Pulp Fiction, Django Unchained and Once Upon a Time in Hollywood.

programme.title: I Am Paul Walker
programme.desc: Documentary exploring the life and legacy of American actor Paul Walker, who rose to fame in the Fast and Furious franchise, but died at the age of 40 after a car crash.

programme.title: Rise of the Superheroes
programme.desc: A look at how the tales of comic book superheroes like Batman and the Avengers were adapted for cinema before going on to dominate Hollywood and captivate audiences worldwide.

programme.title: Lancaster
programme.desc: The story of the bomber synonymous with the Dambusters, the night raids against Germany and the brave men and women who made them possible.

programme.title: JFK Revisited: Through the Looking Glass
programme.desc: Oliver Stone's documentary examining the assassination of US president John F Kennedy, using James DiEugenio's 1992 book Destiny Betrayed: JFK, Cuba and the Garrison Case, and recently declassified US government files to shine a light on what happened in Dallas on November 22, 1963. Narrated by Whoopi Goldberg and Donald Sutherland.

programme.title: Hill
programme.desc: A profile of ex-Formula One driver Damon Hill, revealing how he overcame the adversity of losing his father Graham to follow in his footsteps and become world champion himself.

programme.title: Lockerbie
programme.desc: An investigation into the bombing of Pan Am Flight 103 in December 1988, examining unanswered questions and exploring the truth behind the atrocity that left 270 people dead. With access to victims' families, investigators, intelligence officers and other key figures.

programme.title: Lockerbie
programme.desc: Investigators uncover a key piece of forensic evidence in the form of a fragment of a Toshiba radio that points to an Iran-backed Palestinian terror cell.

programme.title: Lockerbie
programme.desc: A Libyan double agent provides the evidence needed to bring the two suspects to court, but as the trial gets under way a key witness changes his story.

programme.title: Lockerbie
programme.desc: A shock verdict leaves the families unsatisfied, but doubt is cast on the court's decision and 34 years after the bombing, a new suspect is taken into custody.

programme.title: Amsterdam Narcos
programme.desc: Documentary charting how the Dutch city turned into the drug capital of Europe from the 1970s to the early 2000s, turning Amsterdam into a narco-state.

programme.title: Amsterdam Narcos
programme.desc: With a pipeline into British ports in full flow, Amsterdam's ecstasy-makers began to fuel the UK's dancefloors and enthusiasm for drugs.

programme.title: Amsterdam Narcos
programme.desc: With the criminal underworld booming, Dutch law-enforcement officers take a dramatic gamble in a bid to bring down the bosses - with devastating consequences.

programme.desc: Documentary examining the case of Eleanor Williams, who made false claims of grooming gangs in the town of Barrow-in-Furness, Cumbria.

programme.title: Look Away
programme.desc: Documentary hearing from women groomed in their early teenage years by rock stars, as well as exploring the lengths the music industry went to in order to protect its own.

programme.title: My Icon: Natasha Jonas
programme.desc: The boxer speaks about the people who have inspired her career.

programme.title: Pee-wee as Himself
programme.desc: Part one of two. The life and career of actor and comedian Paul Reubens, beginning with his childhood and his rise to fame after the creation of alter ego of Pee-wee Herman.

programme.title: Pee-wee as Himself
programme.desc: The conclusion of the documentary goes behind the scenes of children's series Pee-wee's Playhouse, with Paul Reubens talking candidly about the highs and lows he endured.

programme.title: Spitfire
programme.desc: The story of the British single-seat fighter plane the Supermarine Spitfire, designed by RJ Mitchell and famous for its role in the Battle of Britain. Archive footage, new film of the aircraft in flight and interviews with the last surviving veterans who flew the plane in combat combine to tell its story.

programme.title: David Holmes: The Boy Who Lived
programme.desc: Documentary telling the story of Daniel Radcliffe's Harry Potter stunt double David Holmes, who was left paralysed from the chest down after an on-set accident in 2009. Featuring personal footage shot over the last decade, behind-the-scenes material from Holmes's stunt work, scenes of his current life and interviews with David as well as Daniel Radcliffe, friends, family and former crewmates.

programme.title: Katie Price: Nothing to Hide
programme.desc: Determined to recreate the life she had with Peter Andre, Katie enters a turbulent period of her life, leaving her family and children to navigate the fallout.

programme.title: Tell Them You Love Me
programme.desc: Documentary exploring the story of esteemed university professor Anna Stubblefield's controversial affair with Derrick Johnson, a non-verbal man with cerebral palsy.

programme.title: Tina
programme.desc: Born Anna Mae Bullock in 1939, Tina Turner has sold in excess of 100 million records and earned numerous plaudits including Grammy awards and induction into the Rock And Roll Hall Of Fame with her first husband, Ike Turner. She was the first woman to grace the cover of Rolling Stone magazine and dabbled in acting including a memorable performance opposite Mel Gibson in Mad Max Beyond Thunderdome. Following a prolonged period of ill health, Turner intends to retire from the spotlight with her second husband, Erwin Bach. She bids farewell to her fans in the emotional documentary Tina. Directed by Dan Lindsay and TJ Martin, the film invites the singer to reminisce about her turbulent life and career with glowing contributions from friends, family and fans including Oprah Winfrey and Angela Bassett.

programme.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
programme.desc: With the web-slinger's identity now revealed to the world, Peter Parker asks Doctor Strange for magical help to undo the damage. However, a spell gone wrong unleashes dangerous foes from parallel universes on the world. Comic-book adventure sequel, starring Tom Holland, Zendaya and Benedict Cumberbatch, with Willem Dafoe, Jamie Foxx and Alfred Molina among the stars of past Spider-Man movies reprising their roles.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
programme.desc: After being bitten by a radioactive arachnid, student Miles Morales develops incredible abilities, and becomes a version of Spider-Man. When a super collider device opens a gateway to other dimensions, Miles crosses paths with five counterparts to stop a threat for all realities. Oscar-winning animated adventure, with the voices of Shameik Moore and Nicolas Cage.

programme.title: Spider-Man
programme.desc: A clumsy teenager develops superhuman powers after a genetically engineered spider bites him. At first his fantastic skills delight him, but his elation is severely tempered by a family tragedy, prompting him to dedicate his talents to combating evil. However, he faces a baptism of fire in the form of crazed villain the Green Goblin. Comic-book superhero adventure, with Tobey Maguire, Kirsten Dunst, Willem Dafoe, James Franco and Rosemary Harris.

programme.title: Spider-Man 2
programme.desc: Peter Parker continues his fight for justice, but unrequited love and personal worries take their toll and he is tempted to abandon his web-slinging alter ego. However, the arrival of deadly new bad guy Doctor Octopus plunges him into a race against time to save New York. Comic-book adventure sequel, with Tobey Maguire, Kirsten Dunst, Alfred Molina, James Franco and Rosemary Harris.

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview-July 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky.

programme.title: Spider-Man 3
programme.desc: A sinister alien parasite brings out the web-slinging hero's darker side, filling him with thoughts of revenge on his uncle's murderer, the shape-shifting Sandman. Meanwhile, he also has to contend with the challenge of his best friend following in his father's villainous footsteps - and a jealous rival developing superpowers of his own. Superhero sequel, with Tobey Maguire, Kirsten Dunst and James Franco.

programme.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
programme.desc: A gifted teenager investigates the secrets hidden in his dead parents' past, leading him to a mysterious corporation and an incident that imbues him with superhuman powers. A personal tragedy drives him to use his new-found abilities to fight crime, and he is soon drawn into a deadly battle against a former colleague of his father, who has undergone a devastating transformation of his own. Superhero adventure reboot, starring Andrew Garfield, Emma Stone and Rhys Ifans.

programme.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
programme.desc: The webslinging hero battles a powerful new enemy when a downtrodden engineer develops lethal electrical powers, which he unleashes on those he believes have betrayed him. As if that wasn't enough to keep him busy, he faces an even greater threat when he is reunited with an unstable old friend who has been charged with a sinister mission by his dying father, leading to a series of tense confrontations that threaten to change his life for ever. Superhero adventure sequel, starring Andrew Garfield, Emma Stone, Jamie Foxx and Dane DeHaan.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
programme.desc: Peter Parker balances life as an ordinary high school student with his superhero alter-ego Spider-Man, while waiting in vain to join his mentor Iron Man on a world-saving mission. Determined to prove he is ready for bigger challenges, he investigates a spree of crimes committed with advanced weapons - leading him into a battle with a ruthless winged enemy on the hunt for priceless technology.
